title: Unify axis typography and interactive border geometry for data surfaces
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: Multiple token variants for chart axes, table row borders, and interactive controls have drifted over time. This causes inconsistent stroke widths, misaligned typographic rhythm at small sizes, and unpredictable elevation/shadow treatments when components are used in compact data surfaces. Goal: Consolidate and document a minimal set of tokens that cover axis typography (labels, ticks, legends), border geometry for interactive rows/cells and focus states, and shadow/elevation presets that behave predictably in dense tables and charts. Deliver a migration plan and a backwards-compatible CSS utility mapping for teams to adopt gradually.
design_notes: Anchor tokens around semantic roles rather than component instances: axis-label, axis-tick, chart-legend, table-row, table-cell-border, interactive-focus-outline.
Introduce a compact scale for typography (compact-scale-12/13/14) to avoid fractional line heights at small breakpoints; prefer whole-pixel alignments for 1x/2x density.

Define a small set of elevation ramps optimized for data surfaces: data-surface-0 (flat), data-surface-1 (card subtle), data-surface-2 (overlay), with clear contrast deltas for high and low contrast themes.
Border geometry: unify interactive borders to 1px/2px tokens with consistent corner-radius primitives for dense rows (row-radius-4) and control-radius-6 for standalone controls.
Ensure focus and hover outlines use contrast-aware color tokens (focus-ink-high / focus-ink-neutral) that pass 4.5:1 against surface backgrounds.
Provide Figma components and a token migration guide that maps old tokens to new semantic anchors.
Avoid adding more semantic tokens; prefer composition of existing tokens and a small alias layer for edge cases.
Design validation: run representative dashboards and high-density tables (100+ rows) to surface visual artifacts at real zoom levels.
acceptance_criteria: All axis typography across charts uses the new semantic tokens and matches baseline in Figma for normal and compact scales.
Table rows and interactive cell borders render consistently in light/dark/high-contrast themes; visual diffs run against canary datasets show no regression > 1px misalignment.
New elevation tokens for data surfaces are documented with token values (color overlay / shadow params) and pass contrast/accessibility checks for text above them.

Engineering has a migration stub (CSS utility classes and token aliases) that maps previous token names to new semantic tokens for at least 5 components: Table, DataGrid, LineChart, BarChart, Tooltip.
Figma library updated with component instances using new tokens; QA signoff from Design and Accessibility.
Rollout plan created with a canary cohort and rollback steps; release notes drafted for console-2026.03.
Performance: no measurable regression in paint times for pages with heavy dataviz (benchmarks provided by ENG team remain within +-5% of baseline).
implementation_tasks: Design: finalize token names and generate token export (tokens.json) for engineering.
Design: update Figma components (axis, legend, table-row, cell) and publish library draft.
Engineering: add new tokens to token pipeline and expose aliases in CSS variables (e.g., --rwd-axis-label, --rwd-table-cell-border).
Engineering: implement elevation presets for data surfaces in runtime style config and ensure compositor-friendly shadow formats.
Engineering: add CSS utility classes for compact typography and row-radius utilities for easy adoption in existing codebases.
QA: create visual regression tests for 10 representative dashboards and 3 table variants; include high-contrast mode runs.
PM: coordinate canary rollout with two product teams and compile migration checklist for downstream owners.
Design/Eng: schedule a 30-minute walkthrough and live review with stakeholders before merge.
Docs: update design tokens section in the component library docs and add migration FAQ.
Accessibility: run automated contrast checks and manual keyboard focus validation for interactive rows and controls.
